programme.title: Bassmaster
programme.desc: The Bassmaster Classic is the biggest tournament in the sport of fishing, the 54th running of this event took place in Tulsa, Oklahoma where the diverse field of anglers battle for fishing’s top prize.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Cody Huff
programme.desc: Cody Huff explores the benefits he's found when using various spoons during the late summer. He has dialed in his setups and doesn't experiment with multiple brands of spoons but rather uses the same spoons and changes sizes based on situation. From a magnum spoon to a compact jigging spoon Huff has found success on these from the Tennessee River to the Ozarks and many places in between.

programme.title: Bassmaster
programme.desc: The year-long Bassmaster Elite Series points race, known as the Angler of the Year, is one of the most sought-after awards in all of professional fishing.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Brandon Cobb
programme.desc: Brandon Cobb gives his top picks for effective baits on lakes with blueback herring. Spotted bass and largemouth will get hyper focused on blueback herring when they exist on a body of water and Cobb knows these baits will work throughout the year and not a certain specific season.
